thread:
elaine (docs): Quick note — the API ref curl for /v1/rerank shows queries as a single string. We removed auto-wrapping; examples must use an array of query objects. Opening a tiny docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3250
matt (eng): Yep, runtime expects queries: [{ query: string, top_k?: number }]. Please update examples to the object-array form only.
nina (sdk): I'll update JS/TS snippets afterwards. Our current types still allow legacy shapes; I'll tighten them and add a migration note in the SDK changelog.
jordan (api): Add migration guidance in the docs: "Previously accepted single-string queries are deprecated — send an array of query objects. Results are matched to queries via query_index." Also mention documents can be strings or objects (e.g., { id, text }) for per-doc metadata.
elaine (docs): Can someone paste a concise corrected curl + minimal response I can drop into the PR?
matt (eng): Use this curl example:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rerank-large-v1","queries":[{"query":"Where is tokenization documented?","top_k":5},{"query":"How to set up Dedicated?","top_k":3}],"documents":["Doc A text","Doc B text","Doc C text"]}'

matt (eng): Example response (abridged): {"results":[{"query_index":0,"document_indices":[0,2],"scores":[0.97,0.65]},{"query_index":1,"document_indices":[2,0],"scores":[0.88,0.40]}]}

nina (sdk): Thanks — I'll reference docs PR 3250 in the SDK PR and include a migration note: "If you previously supplied a single string for queries, update to an array of query objects."
ci-bot: docs build for PR 3250 passed — https://ci.redwood.ai/3250/builds/5
elaine (docs): Added curl + response + migration callout and a short note about per-doc metadata. Will merge after one proofread. Thanks!
